testdata/macro-rept.asm:
    1                                           t1 macro arg 
    2                                            t2 arg
    3                                           endm 
    4                                           
    5                                           t2 macro arg
    6                                            t3 arg
    7                                           endm
    8                                           
    9                                           t3 macro arg
   10                                             t4 arg
   11                                           endm
   12                                           
   13                                           t4 macro arg
   14                                              if arg > 0
   15                                               rept [arg, 255]
   16                                                 ld a, $v
   17                                               endr
   18                                             else
   19                                               rept [arg, $ffff]
   20                                                 ld hl, $v
   21                                               endr
   22                                             endif
   23                                           endm
   24                                           
   25                                           t1 0
   25                                         +  t2 arg
   25                                         +  t3 arg
   25                                         +   t4 arg
   25                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
   25                                         + $I = 0(0x0)
   25                                         + $V = 0(0x0)
   25  0000 21 00 00                 [10]     +       ld hl, $v
   25                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
   25                                         + $I = 1(0x1)
   25                                         + $V = 65535(0xffff)
   25  0003 21 ff ff                 [10]     +       ld hl, $v
   25                                         + endm(T4)
   25                                         + endm(T3)
   25                                         + endm(T2)
   25                                         + endm(T1)
   26                                           t1 1
   26                                         +  t2 arg
   26                                         +  t3 arg
   26                                         +   t4 arg
   26                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
   26                                         + $I = 0(0x0)
   26                                         + $V = 1(0x1)
   26  0006 3e 01                    [ 7]     +       ld a, $v
   26                                         + $COUNT = 2(0x2)
   26                                         + $I = 1(0x1)
   26                                         + $V = 255(0xff)
   26  0008 3e ff                    [ 7]     +       ld a, $v
   26                                         + endm(T4)
   26                                         + endm(T3)
   26                                         + endm(T2)
   26                                         + endm(T1)
   27
